import unittest

from shelf.catalog import Catalog
from shelf.models import Book


class Subjects(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_subject_filter(self):
        c = Catalog()
        c.add(Book("1", "Quiet Garden", subjects=["Poetry"]))
        c.add(Book("2", "Quiet Stone", subjects=["History"]))
        self.assertEqual([b.isbn for b in c.search("quiet subject:poetry")], ["1"])
        self.assertEqual([b.isbn for b in c.by_subject("history")], ["2"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
